note: Seed data for the proof-of-concept. Records are the two SpoC-128 results that exist as checked Lean in trailofbits/random-systems; nothing here has been through the (unbuilt) verifier.

spoc128.description: Three-query key recovery. `attack_distinguishing_advantage` proves advantage exactly 1 for every key and every permutation; `parAttack_wins_above` extends it to every larger budget.
Six-call DSL form: three challenge queries plus three public-permutation calls, with proved step and call bounds (`source_calls_le`).
